svg.title: Eddies: architecture
svg.desc: An Eddie is a primitive bound to a task frame, an identified closed-loop model and a conformal envelope, all in one token. Streamer composes the Eddie stream from an LTLf goal through a product-game supervisor; the tubes chain through hand-overs into a whole-task certificate; the gate checks every command before it is sent and stops the robot otherwise; the self-calibrating gate moves the coverage level q after every episode and refits the models at hand-overs. Five stages build up in a 14 s loop.

text.tspan: 11 primitives, each robot's own vocabulary; models
fitted and envelopes calibrated on rollouts
α = 0.1: a new episode stays inside every envelope
Streamer: the strategy of the product game is the Eddie stream
hand-over bound, Theorem 1(a); tube (4) inside each Eddie
updated models and envelopes flow back into the Eddies: Theorem 1(c), miss rate → α
